snippet.description:

Gyakuten Live!

An "Ace Attorney"-styled fangame based on the Love Live! franchise. Travel through the adventures of your favourite school idols as you solve mysteries and prove the innocence of your clients.

During Yu and Ayumu's vacation to the town of Numazu, a larceny occurs in the local aquarium, Sea Paradise, as a donated sculpture has gone missing. Local school idol and employee Watanabe You is singled out as the top suspect. However, it looks like Yu and Ayumu aren't the only school idols from Tokyo in the town of Numazu, as a familiar face has recently taken up the role of being a prosecutor and intends to seize victory in this case...!
